selected_exploratory_stratum.outcome_individuals: 36 original breeding solitary nest IDs, excluding poorly observed solo27
selected_exploratory_stratum.source_early_neighbor_definition: at least one finite n_neighbors > 0 at a 2021 nest check on or before December 1
selected_exploratory_stratum.source_egg_detection: first 2021 check with numeric 1 or 2 eggs, excluding original unknown 8/9 codes
selected_exploratory_stratum.source_incubation_detection: first status containing INC, but P/INC ambiguity retained as observed incubation-type only
selected_exploratory_stratum.source_creche: cr_confirm > 0 is direct confirmation; absence of confirmation not confirmed mortality

ordering_falsification: Classify earliest recorded egg before / same calendar date / after first observed neighbor for every early-neighbor nest
Classify earliest recorded INC status before / same / after the earliest observed neighbor, retaining uncertainties
Report the last explicitly zero-neighbor check before first positive neighbor where observable, as event-time interval censoring
Report observation counts and distinct observation days by Dec 1 for exposed and unexposed nests
No invented inferred egg-laying date based on first egg sighting or presumed nest history
First positive neighbor is a detection date, NOT true first arrival or treatment assignment
Explicitly do not infer causality from egg observed after first neighbor because egg detection may lag laying
If egg was documented before neighbor, neighbor detection cannot have caused that original egg to appear
preexposed_preliminary_original_data_pat: Among 9 early-neighbor nests, 5 already have an egg detected before first positive neighbor, 2 same day, 2 later; this is source audit not new independent hypothesis test.
forbidden: Do not call same-day nesting record a strictly prior cause
Do not use unknown egg status 8/9 as known zero
Do not turn neighbor arrival detected after prior incubation into a proof of social settlement attraction
Do not interpret observed nest failure as survival without detection correction
Do not claim group founding, independent nest-to-chick recruitment or beneficial social causality from a single colony
Do not fit p-values on outcome-exposed hypotheses or modify frozen PR189
